profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Skylight
profile.summary: Self-taught software engineer who began programming at age 9, with 15+ years of professional experience building backend, cloud, and AI workflow platforms across startup and enterprise environments.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Helping build Skylight's AI Assistant, an SMS-based agent that helps families manage their daily life. Focused on backend reliability, personalization, and safety/quality systems that make it smarter and more trustworthy.
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · AI Agents · AI Evaluation

positions.title: Founding Co-Head of Engineering
positions.description:
• Scaled an early-stage MVP into a production AI-powered talent optimization platform serving 20+ enterprise customers, processing thousands of candidate applications per week across AI-assisted assessment, candidate data workflows, structured evaluations, and workforce analytics.
• Architected the core TypeScript/AWS serverless workflow platform using Step Functions, Lambda, Batch, S3, RDS, and CDK, with custom type-safe workflow tooling, dynamic Lambda/Batch workload routing, and local infrastructure automation that cut test cycles from ~1 hour to under 5 minutes.
• Recruited by co-founders as founding engineering leader and hands-on Staff-level contributor, building the engineering function from zero to 8 people while owning production reliability, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, 20+ customer integrations, and model-driven hiring workflows tied to customer-reported attrition-cost reduction and multi-million-dollar impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Progressed from Software Engineer to Staff — the highest individual contributor level — over 4 years at a top digital product consultancy, driven by technical leadership across engagements, cross-org mentorship, and strategic client work.
• Led backend and cloud implementation for Pepsi/Bobcat, building C#/.NET Core APIs for QR-code contactless payments and account charging across mobile apps and dispenser hardware, owning observability, CI/CD pipelines, and client-facing architecture reviews for an 18-month engagement.
• Built and owned the backend and AWS infrastructure for the Mastercard Pay with Rewards platform — a Spring Boot/Java application on ECS/Fargate with Aurora Postgres — managing multi-environment deployments, third-party vendor transitions, and production incident response; recognized by Mastercard engineering leadership by name in a senior executive review.
• Migrated a Sony motion/volumetric capture proof-of-concept from on-premises to AWS using S3, Lambda, Batch, Step Functions, and EC2 Image Builder, contributing to a cloud render pipeline that earned survey scores of 9–10/10 from Sony senior management.
• Served as de facto tech lead across multiple engagements, regularly owning client-facing architecture presentations, scoping sessions, and technical stakeholder relationships at the VP and SVP level.
• Mentored engineers and interns across the organization, conducted technical interviews, and co-founded and led the Trees Without Degrees ERG for self-taught and non-traditionally credentialed engineers.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
• Led all engineering as a hands-on CTO, splitting time evenly between architecture/leadership and individual contribution, while owning hiring and team growth for a 4-person engineering function.
• Built and operated the full technology stack for a live gaming and esports streaming network — including AWS Elemental-based streaming infrastructure, OTT platform distribution across 12+ networks, PHP web properties, and backend content systems.
• Designed and shipped Wind, a React Native social networking app for gamers featuring algorithmic matchmaking, real-time chat, and cross-platform game discovery.

positions.title: Chief Product Officer
positions.description: Lead the creation WordPatch, the first WordPress plugin to allow modification of plugins without losing the ability to update.

positions.title: Partner
positions.description:
• Delivered custom software solutions for Nike, Google, Apple, and Wolfgang Puck as part of a 4-person engineering and design shop, specializing in high-stakes experiential marketing activations requiring flawless live event execution.
• Built and deployed mobile check-in systems, product interest apps, and event registration platforms for Nike activations across the US and Canada, operating live at events with athletes and thousands of attendees.
• Developed a Google experiential gallery installation in Washington DC using Django and Google App Engine, and maintained ongoing web platform work for Wolfgang Puck and other clients on AWS.

positions.title: Partner / Software Developer
positions.description:
• Co-built Lighter2, a custom PHP MVC framework used as the foundation for all client engagements, enabling consistent, testable, and scalable application development across projects.
• Architected and delivered client applications across the LAMP stack, owning everything from data modeling and API design to project management and client consultation.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Built features and infrastructure for RoleStar, a social video entertainment platform where users performed movie scenes via webcam — built on PHP with AWS/RightScale, S3, Cloudant, MySQL, and RabbitMQ.

positions.title: Plugin Developer / Moderator
positions.description:
- Researching new methods to modify the Source Engine.
- Developing extensions and plugins for extending the SourceMod platform.
- Moderating new plugin submissions, guarding against malware and buggy behavior.

positions.title: Owner / Web Developer
positions.description:
- Building and hosting websites for local businesses.
- Repairing misconfigured servers.
- Providing service level on-call customer support.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Building an online ordering system on top of existing eCommerce framework.
- Researching cost effective point-of-sales solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Writing custom plugins to help create inventive Machinimas.
- Building and maintaining official website.

honors.title: Very Special Person Award
honors.description:
I was given this as a tribute to my after-school Computer Science program.

It reads, "In recognition for outstanding service to the youth of our community and for going far above and beyond for our great Palos Verdes High School! We thank you!"

Unfortunately, they spelled my last name incorrectly :(
honors.issuer: Issued by Palos Verdes High School Staff · Mar 2011

projects.title: Lighter
projects.description: Lighter is IMK's official framework for PHP. As its name implies, the intention was to build it to be as lightweight as possible. Lighter comes equipped with the tools needed to build a REST-ful PHP application. As of recently, we have also developed a Lighter testing framework that can process specifications written in English with native PHP throughout.

projects.title: Creative Therapy Store
projects.description: Creative Therapy Store is an eCommerce business specialized in children therapy. I was initially brought on the project to maintain the application layer. Later on, I added support for cut and paste AB testing. Using this system, CTS is able to continuously expand their demographic by non-intrusively experimenting with multiple versions of an advertisement or product special. Additionally, their unique needs led to the introduction of a complex discount engine. Creative Therapy Store's non-traditional style of product placement makes for excellent software challenges.
